decisions.reason: Adding the completed board to JLCPCB does not change the existing BOM content, part-number, board-specific BOM, or optional-connector assembly requirements.
Adding the board to JLCPCB enables inspection but does not change the existing requirement to verify component orientations.
The order-setup decision does not alter the requirement that every board use lead-free manufacturing.
The source asks to add the completed board to JLCPCB but does not change any component availability, sourcing, fallback, or JLCPCB Basic-component policy.
Adding a board to JLCPCB does not modify the required set of production export files.
The source decision does not add, remove, or alter the QR-code marking requirement.
Submitting the board to JLCPCB does not change the integrated-board connector mounting technology.
The JLCPCB order-setup instruction does not modify the target or location of connector pin labels.
The source does not resolve or change the battery connector type, pin functions, access, compatibility, or unresolved physical pin order.
Adding the completed board to JLCPCB has no necessary effect on the enclosure's accommodation, mounting, airflow, assembly, or retention requirements.
The manufacturing-order setup does not change the power board's dimensions, orientation, mounting holes, connector placement, or enclosure-fit constraints.
The source decision does not modify the interboard power connector, topology, matching rule, distribution behavior, or pinout.
